uncertainties: Chosen bearer is provisional terminology for tekikakusha pending glossary research. The dream deliberately leaves the speaker's identity and the other key unclear.
text:
Then take me in hand.
If you wish to survive,
inherit my power.
Survive...
Now, reach out
and seize me!
Back then...
I chose of my own free will
to take hold of it.
Back then...
I chose of my own free will
to take hold of it...
To survive.
To keep the promise
I made to that child.
This sword...
But why
did it have to be me?
Of all the people
who were there, why
did it come to me...?
This sword...
But why
did it have to be me?
Of all the people
who were there, why
did it come to me...?
Because you
were a chosen bearer.
That is why.
!?
!?
The power within the sword
yearns to return
to where it belongs.
To free itself
from its cramped cage,
it needs a key.
Knowledge found you,
and power found him.
So that a complete inheritance
could take place...
You...
Who are you!?
You...
Who are you!?
Are you the sword's will?
Are you the sword's will?
You could say that...
Or you could say I am not...
I am the same as what
you call the sword's will,
but the sword's will
is not me...
...?
...?
Wavelength, radiance, form.
Only one who possesses all three
can open the lock.
That is a chosen bearer.
A chosen bearer...
A chosen bearer...
It means
inheriting
everything.
Boundless knowledge
and overwhelming power.
And...
Ghh... ugh!?
!?
!?
There's no... time...
Any... more...
Aaaaargh!!
Hold on!
There are still things
I need to ask you!
Wait!
There are still things
I need to ask you!
